dct_title_s: Typus orarum maritimarum Guineæ, Manicongo Angôlæ ultra promontorium Bonæ spei usq.
dct_description_sm: Coordinates approximate and based on Greenwich meridian.
Includes descriptive text in Latin and Dutch.
Bar scales on map: "Miliaria Germanica, quorum 15.uni gradui respondent" and "Hispanice leuce 17 1/2. uni gradui competentia".
Companion map to NOR 0239b, which form a map of Africa and the surrounding seas. This map is from the Dutch edition published in 1596. The sea contains two compass roses.

Norwich, I., Pam Kolbe, and Jeffrey C Stone. Norwich's Maps of Africa: An Illustrated and Annotated Carto-Bibliography. 2nd ed. / rev. and edited by Jeffrey C. Stone. Norwich, Vt.: Terra Nova Press, 1997, map 0239a, p. 274
David Rumsey Map Center copy 1: Map of Africa no. MOA0146.
David Rumsey Map Center copy 1: Norwich no. NOR 0239a.
